items.title: Missing traffic-failover behaviour
items.description: The design shows two replicas but does not define traffic behaviour when one application instance is unavailable.
items.recommended_change: Describe the failure path and update the deployment diagram to show how traffic is handled when a replica is unavailable.

items.title: Missing RTO and RPO
items.description: The Solution Intent does not define recovery time or recovery point objectives.
items.recommended_change: Record the product-approved RTO and RPO values in the Solution Intent.

items.title: Undefined production support ownership
items.description: The production support team and escalation path have not been assigned.
items.recommended_change: Name the production support owner and document the escalation path before release approval.

Confirm the RTO and RPO values
